text: とても　きれいに　みがかれた　まど　だ！

structure.jp: とても　きれいに　みがかれた

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending says the action was done to the thing, not by it. みがかれた = 'was polished'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: きれいに　みがかれた　まど
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. きれいに　みがかれた　まど = 'a window that was polished clean'.

patterns.name: 〜に (adverb)
patterns.explanation: に after a describing word like きれい turns it into a word for how something is done. きれいに = 'cleanly'.
